validate.future_date: the date {date} is in the future
validate.ancient_date: the date {date} is too old to be a real trade
validate.unknown_ticker: we don't recognise {ticker} — it imports, but may show no price if it's your broker's own code (SAN instead of SAN.MC)
validate.zero_price_sell: sold at 0 — right if the company went bust or was delisted; the whole position counts as a loss
validate.duplicate: this exact trade is already in your portfolio or earlier in the file — importing it again counts it twice
validate.near_duplicate: your portfolio or this file already has a {action} of {quantity} {ticker} on {date} at another price — probably the same trade read twice
validate.oversell: sells {quantity} but only {held} were held on {date} — is an earlier buy or a split missing?
validate.split_added: added a {ratio}:1 split on {date} from Yahoo — your statement doesn't show it, and the later sells don't add up without it
